name: batch-view-det (the history of the batches opened from the Agents screen: empty, unreadable, a first page that reads on, its filters; then the view of a batch opened from it: its summary and table, the detail of an item, the decision of a waiting item, a refused command, pause, export, stop, a batch that no longer exists, one that cannot be read)
notes: The stubs imitate BatchView and BatchDetailView (GET /api/v1/batches, GET /api/v1/batches/{id}, the four controls), BatchAccess (GET /api/v1/batches/accesses), PendingDecision and DecideResponse (GET /api/v1/pending-decisions, POST .../decide) and the task timeline. The export is cancelled at the save dialog: writing a file is the shell's part, covered by its own tests.
